integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled verifier checks representative stationary equations and numerical optimizations but is not an exhaustive novelty certificate or an independent review.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the Blackwell deterministic broadcast map and the mutually confidential classical-message capacity formula of arXiv:2609.26750v1. The frontier is implicit through a monotone transcendental involution; no elementary closed form away from symmetry and endpoints is claimed. Equivalent parametrizations under different terminology remain a residual literature risk.
title: Exact odds parametrization of the confidential Blackwell Pareto frontier
